parsed.attack: $4/month is below the bottom of the $8-24 payer band and nets $2.80 after the store fee. At the stated 3% trial conversion, a $5.84 iOS install costs $195 per subscriber - 70 months of gross revenue - and even the $20-80 CPPU band implies a 7-29 month payback on a product that is dormant from November to February, so realistic paid tenure is 8-10 months a year worth $22-28 net. Every paid channel is therefore closed and the only channel left is the 10 allotment associations kill line three asks for. The ceiling is hard too: roughly 330,000 allotment plots in England, so 100% national saturation at 3% conversion is under 10,000 subscribers, about $36k/month gross, and realistic 5% reach is closer to $1,800/month.
parsed.strongest_defence: Bill annually at $30-40 up front to bridge the winter dormancy and pull lifetime value above the CPPU band, then acquire through community_embed - association newsletters and noticeboards - at zero CAC, with inference at fractions of a cent per briefing keeping gross margin near 100%.
parsed.verdict_reason: Inference cost is negligible, but a $4/month seasonal subscription netting $2.80 cannot repay even the $20 low end of the paying-user acquisition band, so the product lives or dies on free association channels into a market capped around 330,000 plots.
